status.description: The notes to update on the workbench result. On a user resteer, this must reset `objective` (and replace todos and working_theory) to the new task.

todos.description: The todos to update. Always pass the full list. If a user resteers, replace this list to match the new objective rather than carrying over todos from the previous task.

name.description: The name of the todo.  This should be space separated words and all lowercase.

topology.description: A mermaid diagram of the topology of the system in question in this investigation. We will validate mermaid syntax and reply with an error if invalid.

objective.description: The sole current objective for this investigation, persisted on the workbench result. You MUST reset this whenever a user resteers or sends a follow-up that redefines the task — write the new objective, do not reuse the previous one. Leaving the old objective after a resteer is incorrect; the result field is not cleared unless you overwrite it. Pass the existing objective unchanged only when the latest user prompt does not change the task.

working_theory.description: The current working theory. If a user resteers, rewrite this for the new objective instead of keeping the previous theory. Pass the old theory only if the task has not changed.

summary.description: A summary of the notes change you made
